svg.aria-label: An acoustic-coupler tape deck that explains how Pinkall coaches a sales call live. A telephone handset rests in two coupler cups: the call audio, seller and prospect. A closed knife switch stands for transcription consent. The tape runs from the supply reel across two heads to the take-up reel, over a ruler with one tick per 80 millisecond block; the second head is the live read, wired to a dial gauge with marks at 0.6 and 0.85 whose needle rests past 0.85: the turn has ended. That trips a gantry over a tray of index cards, which lifts exactly one card out of fifty: the one suggestion shown during the call, the only pink part. The take-up reel keeps the whole call; after the stop key, a slip printer prints the debrief: notes and one improvement.
svg.title: Pinkall live call coach
